# Use-case training packs

Each pack maps one real-world use case to the skills it needs, the courses in the database that teach them, gaps in coverage, and milestones for building it. Add a pack by creating `data/packs/<id>.json` (see [docs/PACKS.md](../../docs/PACKS.md)).
